text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (March 3, 2025) for 3896 Bathurst Street, 105.

The Property Standards Committee – North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (March 3, 2025) for 3896 Bathurst Street, 105, Folder Number 25 123189 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 2, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
